calls.price_at_call: DCF FV $26.90 (stated) vs current ~$26 (stated ~3% gap); forward P/E 37.6
calls.thesis: First tracked Parkev call on Hims & Hers: reiterates his 14 Sep rating of 'buying opportunity, medium conviction' but is waiting for a more attractive entry - the stock is fairly valued today and volatile, so he expects a better dip. Revenue +40% to $753M, ~3M members after 300k net adds, international revenue up 17x to $131M after the Eucalyptus deal; long-term guide $6.5B revenue / $1.3B adj. EBITDA vs $2.6B TTM revenue.
calls.bear_case: Margins are contracting while revenue grows: operating margin 0.3% (was ~8%), ROIC reversed from ~35% to -8.4%; heavy further investment in manufacturing, marketing and expansion still needed.

calls.thesis: Revenue +40% YoY with international expansion, but margin/FCF pressure plus unresolved GLP-1 lawsuit overhang; wait-and-see, shorts not wrong.
calls.base_case: Base: growth intact, legal overhang caps upside near PT $32.
calls.bull_case: Lawsuit resolved + targets raised -> 26.7% short interest fuels a squeeze.
calls.bear_case: Legal overhang persists; ~$65 2025 high a long way off.
